Issue #15 is a standalone easy-call for bounded current-main regression qualification and a loader-side correction if reproduced. Two-way: the anticipated change is internal refresh loading plus focused tests, not a public API or persisted format. At pinned main 4cabe417c868b343fa458a6e42b1da7a4813ec52, CascadingActions.REFRESH intentionally skips entity collection traversal. LoaderSelectBuilder joins at most the first collection under a cascading fetch profile; nested bag collections use select-eager fetching. AbstractNonJoinCollectionInitializer reuses existing persistent collections and registers eager secondary initialization only for newly wrapped or uninitialized collections. This leaves a concrete path where an initialized nested collection receives no secondary query, while EntityInitializerImpl can refresh cascaded entities only when their rows are actually processed. This is a code-supported hypothesis, not a runtime-confirmed diagnosis.

Marián Ligocký supplied the three-entity H2 reproducer attached to HHH-21009. Both List collections are initialized, their owning ManyToOne sides synchronized, and a native SQL mutation changes Child.label before refresh(root). Reported 7.2.24 success and 7.4 failures are reporter claims. Runtime RED must be established on unchanged current main before any production fix; stop this issue if absent or if a safe correction demands broad loader redesign.

Preserve the merged HHH-18774 optimization: existing CascadeRefreshToManyTest explicitly asserts a single SQL query for shallow collection and to-one cascades. Do not revert CascadingActions wholesale. The closed-unmerged #13160 review confirms cascade REFRESH must not be silently suppressed merely because an association is lazy. Test managed identity, initialized and initially uninitialized nested collections, no-cascade boundaries, and the existing refresh package. Prefer the responsible collection/loading layer rather than downstream lifecycle suppression. Keep configuration options explicit and reuse context already available.
